profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
Graduated in May 2019 with a Computer Science degree and a concentration of Software Engineering.

Full-stack software engineer with extensive experience in ReactJS/Node, SQL, AWS, and Java with a passion for using my development experience to help others and tackle interesting and challenging problems. 

I am open-minded, have a passion to learn, and confident in using my knowledge and skills to get the job done. I am open to stretching out of my comfort zones to perform duties that are necessary.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Full stack developer responsible for customization and integration of enterprise software to improve the efficiency of the Claims division of CIG Insurance.
- Developed solutions for integration existing technology with and enterprise application using ReactJS/Node, SQL, AWS, Java/Gosu, .NET (VB.NET, ASP.NET, C#).
- Improved data integrity and security for AWS application through implementation of user role management.
- Upgraded continuous integration processes for internal applications by refactoring and integrating with Jenkins.
- Improved code quality through functional test automation using Selenium and Cucumber frameworks.

positions.title: CS Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Facilitated guided learning in Database Systems course using SQLite and Java, Software Design course using Java, and Multimedia Design & Programming course using Python.
- Helped students meet their course learning outcomes through lab/homework help, office hours, review sessions.

positions.title: Intern, Naval Research Enterprise Internship Program
positions.description:
- 12-week internship at Monterey Naval Research Laboratory.
- Project included developing pipeline to process weather metadata for Navy Air Quality model using Python, Cylc workflow engine, and Fortran.

honors.title: Certified Open Water Diver
honors.description: NAUI Certified Open Water Diver in Monterey, CA

honors.title: 3rd Place in the IIED Tech Hackathon
honors.description:
- Placed 3rd in three-day competition to develop solution that would tackle a community issue.
- Created a scavenger hunt game that enables users to engage in a self-guided tour around the Cal State University Monterey Bay campus via QR codes
honors.issuer: Issued by Institute for Innovation and Economic Development · Nov 2016

volunteerExperiences.description: Participated in the 3-week Global Glimpse program, a global education, leadership, and service learning organization. Worked closely with team and locals to decide on and work on a project to improve a community.

projects.title: Meme Generator
projects.description:
- Group Python project for the class Multimedia Design & Programming, creating a program to design memes 
- Implemented function for captioning images
